detail.title: NC270 RGB Gaming Laptop Cooling Stand
detail.overview: The Ant Esports NC270 packs a heterogeneous 5-fan setup into a rugged hexagonal design, combining four 140mm ducted fans (up to 900 RPM) with a mini 70mm centrifugal fan capable of reaching 2500 RPM for focused, rapid heat dissipation. Reinforced ABS plastic and aluminium construction with a metal grid top optimizes airflow for large, high-end gaming laptops, while a completely flat design keeps the pad sturdy and stable during marathon sessions. A front touch control bar lets you switch between auto and manual airflow modes across 6 total speed levels, and an LCD screen shows live settings at a glance. Two adjustable angles and dual USB ports round out a genuinely premium cooling solution built for laptops up to 17 inches.
